```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(performance)
library(see)
library(ggplot2)
library(robustlmm)
library(lattice)

d2 <- read.csv('Scale_D2_Final.csv')
d2$X <- NULL
```


```{r}
d2$Explanation.Type <- as.factor(d2$Explanation.Type)
d2$QuestionID <- as.factor(d2$Question.ID)
d2$Participant <- as.factor(d2$Participant)

library(lmerTest)
model_d2_alt <- lmer(Total.Score ~ Explanation.Type +
       (1 | Participant) + (1 | QuestionID),
     data = d2)

summary(model_d2_alt)
confint(model_d2_alt)
icc(model_d2_alt, by_group = TRUE)
```

Check Normality of residuals
```{r}

qqmath(model_d2_alt)

#Add formal test
shapiro.test(resid(model_d2_alt)) #Shapiro Wilkes is significant but the tails look okay so we'll keep it!
```


Look at Homogeneity of Variance
```{r}
plot(fitted(model_d2_alt), resid(model_d2_alt))
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

library(car)
leveneTest(residuals(model_d2_alt) ~ d2$Explanation.Type)
```

Test for Normality of Participant Random Effect
```{r}
re <- ranef(model_d2_alt)$Participant[, 1]
qqnorm(re)
qqline(re)
shapiro.test(re)

library(lattice)
dotplot(ranef(model_d2_alt, condVar = TRUE))
```
Test for Normality of Question ID Random Effects next
```{r}
re <- ranef(model_d2_alt)$QuestionID[, 1]
qqnorm(re)
qqline(re)
shapiro.test(re)

library(lattice)
dotplot(ranef(model_d2_alt, condVar = TRUE))
```


```{r}
isSingular(model_d2_alt)
summary(model_d2_alt)$optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
```
